title: A2v10 metadata.json (profile)
description: The user's own settings: one file at profile/metadata.json, a row per user (usr.Profile, keyed by the login), a column per slot. A slot is read by 'initialValues' with source 'profile' - of a record and of a report's filter - and edited by the user alone on the profile page (section 'Defaults'). Only a value with no carrier row: what belongs to a record (a company's currency) is a field of that record.

description.description: For the model, not the platform: nothing reads it.

fields.description: The slots. A slot read by 'initialValues' has the type and target of the field it starts - refused at load otherwise.
